en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from Safwan Bin Yahya, from Mansour Bin Hazim, from Bakr Bin Habeeb, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The water of the bathhouse, there is no problem with it, if there was a source for it (like a fountain)’.
en.sarwar: 2. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id from Safwan ibn Yahya from Mansur ibn Hazim from Bakr ibn Habib who has said the following: “Abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Water of bathhouses does not have problems if it is water from a large source; like a fountain.’”
